title: Maximum Floor Area Ratio for Certain Uses
previewText: In Subdistricts A and C, the maximum floor area ratio permitted for commercial uses shall be 6.0, except that the maximum floor area ratio for uses listed in Section 104-13 (Commercial and Manufacturing Use Modifications) shall be 2.0.
